svg.text: W1 p54: three Jacobians, one wire
the fourth: a Transformer layer, Norm included
Xiong et al. 2020 make it a theorem at initialization:
post-LN's last layers get gradients that do not shrink with depth;
pre-LN's do — hence warmup and small LR for post-LN (qualitative here)
Jacobians ignore the gates' own dependencies and the Norm's gain — our framing
